content_sections.heading: IIT Ropar Senior Project Associate at a Glance
content_sections.text: Register for Job Alerts Indian Institute of Technology Ropar (IIT Ropar) has announced 1 vacancy for the Senior Project Associate post on a project-based tenure of four years, initially for three months with extension based on yearly performance. The notified pay is Rs. 57,000 + 10% HRA per month, and applicants must hold a four years Bachelor's Degree in Natural or Agricultural Sciences/Master's Degree in Natural or Agricultural Sciences/BVSC/BPharm or bachelor's degree in Engineering or Technology or Medicine from a recognized University or equivalent. Eligible candidates can apply by email, sending a single PDF file with the required documents to the specified address on or before 28 October 2026. The selection process consists of shortlisting based on application and qualifications, followed by an interview.

rows.details: Indian Institute of Technology Ropar (IIT Ropar)
ANRF funded PAIR Project – DREAMS consortium
Four years (initially three months with extension based on yearly performance)

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess one of the following minimum educational qualifications from a recognized University or equivalent: Four years Bachelor's Degree in Natural or Agricultural Sciences, or Master's Degree in Natural or Agricultural Sciences, or BVSC, or BPharm, along with four years of experience in R&D in industrial and academic institutions or S&T organizations and scientific activities and services. Master's Degree in Engineering or Technology from a recognized university or equivalent, along with two years of experience in R&D in industrial and academic institutions or S&T organizations and scientific activities and services. Doctoral Degree in Science, Engineering, Technology, Pharma, MD, or Master of Surgery from a recognized University or equivalent. Desirable Qualifications: Previous project-related work experience and managerial skills; proficiency in computer applications and accounting; good knowledge of English for email communication, reporting, and presentations; ability to handle a team of 4-5 members effectively; good analytical, reasoning, and problem-solving skills; writing, editing, proofreading, layout and design, and professional printing/publishing skills; good interpersonal and negotiation skills; self-motivation and a wide degree of creativity. Age Limit: Not more than 45 years.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The position of Senior Project Associate offers a consolidated fellowship or salary of Rs. 57,000 plus 10% HRA per month. The duration of the project is four years. Initially, the appointment will be for three months, with the possibility of extension based on performance on a yearly basis. The post is co-terminus with the project. content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Ropar Senior Project Associate
content_sections.text: Prepare a detailed updated CV including your photo, category, marital status, contact number, and email address. Compile previous work experience details if any. Gather a Government-issued photo identity proof and age proof (original and photocopy). Arrange certificates in descending order starting from the last degree up to class 10th, along with mark sheets. Merge all required documents into a single PDF file in the defined order. Send your email application directly to [email protected] clearly mentioning the position applied for. Ensure the subject of the email reads exactly: Application - First Name Last name_Position applied for .

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates will be evaluated based on the submitted application documents and qualifications. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. Candidates must produce original certificates and mark sheets in support of educational qualifications and age at the time of joining for verification.

faq.question: Q1. Is this post permanent or on contract, and for how long?
faq.answer: The post is co-terminus with the four-year ANRF funded PAIR Project – DREAMS consortium. Initially, the appointment is for three months, with the possibility of extension on a yearly basis based on performance.

faq.question: Q2. Are HRA or allowances paid on top of the pay?
faq.answer: Yes, the Senior Project Associate receives a monthly salary of Rs. 57,000 plus 10% HRA per month.

faq.question: Q3. What is the required email subject line for submitting the application?
faq.answer: The subject of the email must be formatted as: Application - First Name Last name_Position applied for.

faq.question: Q4. What are the desirable qualifications for this position?
faq.answer: Desirable qualifications include previous project-related work experience, managerial skills, computer and accounting proficiency, strong English communication and presentation skills, team management abilities, problem-solving skills, publishing and editing capabilities, and self-motivation.
